E0220

A place is read through its owner while an exclusive write window into it is still live.

What

A place is read through its owner while an exclusive write window into it is still live.

Why

An exclusive window (a pin or a mutable view) already gives write access to that storage; reading the owner beside it would be rejected after lowering.

Fix

Read or edit through the live window name instead of the owner.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0220: tests/ui/ownership/match_place_optional_payload_window_rejects_aliasing.stderr.

Error [jet.ReadDuringWriteWindow]: `counter.value` cannot be read while `n` has a live exclusive write window into it
  --> match_place_optional_payload_window_rejects_aliasing.jet:9:27
    |
  9 |             print(counter.value ?? 0)
    |                           ^^^^^
 Why: `n` is an exclusive window into `counter.value`; reading the owner beside that window would be rejected after lowering
 Fix: Read or edit through `n` instead of `counter.value`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0220

Error [jet.OwnerMovedWhileViewed]: `maybe` cannot be assigned while `n` is still looking into it
  --> match_place_optional_payload_window_rejects_aliasing.jet:20:13
    |
 20 |             maybe = None
    |             ^^^^^
 Why: `n` is a live exclusive mutable view into `maybe`; changing or moving the owner could invalidate that view
 Fix: Finish using `n` before changing `maybe`, narrow the view's scope, or make an owned copy
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0212
